title: STRIKERS 1945 / PSIKYO-FABTEK CONVERSION
variant: Black conversion upright with original-design Strikers marquee, portrait display and gray Fabtek operator panel
preview_note: 32 x 48 px | Black conversion upright with original-design Strikers marquee, portrait display and gray Fabtek operator panel

rom_validation.matching: All required files match pinned FBNeo CRC32 and size; existing legacy aliases are accepted.

cabinet.purpose: Low-resolution archive conversion cabinet, black shell and portrait monitor; original-design Strikers 1945 plane marquee. Its red deck differs from the selected gray Fabtek operator panel and is not reused. No unique factory-dedicated cabinet is claimed.
cabinet.rights: Underlying printed artwork Psikyo / Fabtek; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photo/scan author, replacement-print status and redistribution permission remain unverified.

marquee.purpose: Plane/title marquee rectified from the documented Strikers 1945 conversion photo; not Strikers 1945 II, III or Neo Geo Plus artwork.
marquee.rights: Underlying printed artwork Psikyo / Fabtek; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photo/scan author, replacement-print status and redistribution permission remain unverified.

controls.purpose: Gray repeated-Fabtek operator panel photograph with two black sticks, duplicated Shoot/Bomb pairs (blue left, green right) and two white Start buttons. All duplicated physical action caps are modeled; Start remains photographed.
controls.rights: Underlying printed artwork Psikyo / Fabtek; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photo/scan author, replacement-print status and redistribution permission remain unverified.

flyer.purpose: 1995 Psikyo Strikers 1945 promotional print with aircraft art credited to Yoshiyuki Takani, corroborates the first game/plane/title imagery; not fabricated cabinet side art.
flyer.rights: Underlying printed artwork Psikyo; illustration credited to Yoshiyuki Takani; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photo/scan author, replacement-print status and redistribution permission remain unverified.

screen.purpose: Real 224x320 Stage 1 aircraft gameplay from supplied World ROMs and new Psikyo 68EC020 WASM core: nine-coin state, Start 15 frames, one first-action confirmation, then 600 neutral frames.
screen.rights: Game imagery Psikyo, captured from user-supplied local ROM only. No ROM downloaded, uploaded or committed; no redistribution license inferred.

uncertainties: Publisher-hosted artwork masters were not found. Archive photographs/scans are not proof of factory prints or artwork redistribution permission.
This selected shell/kit interpretation is explicit; ROM, hardware and seat count are not changed to suit artwork. No map placement or uploads included.

Strikers 1945 is a JAMMA kit. The black conversion shell/marquee and gray Fabtek operator deck are an explicit operator interpretation, not a factory-exclusive cabinet or a silent claim that the photographed red deck is Fabtek gray.
Plain black sides follow the conversion photo; no unverified character/aircraft side print is invented.

The photographed panel duplicates the two Shoot/Bomb actions on alternate sides of each joystick; four physical action buttons per station are modeled with measured per-station offsets, two white Start buttons remain photographed. FBNeo also exposes a third optional action descriptor, not an extra invented operator button.
The selected cabinet/marquee photo is only 158x222; title/aircraft detail is consequently limited, not substituted with another game's art.

Ten supplied ROMs match. MCU 4-u59.bin is undumped (BRF_NODUMP), its protection is handled by FBNeo; no download or new BIOS is needed. The new per-system Psikyo core must be served alongside the game before browser play.
